items.title: Consumer spending sees the smallest increase in seven months. Is the economy getting weaker?
items.content: Consumer spending rose in July at the slowest pace in seven months, suggesting the U.S. economy lost a little steam after the end of the 2026 Word Cup and start of the third quarter.

items.title: U.S. inflation rises again and stays well above the Fed’s target. A rate hike could be in play.
